headline: Senate Weighs Afternoon Impeachment Schedule as Reports Differ on Start Time
seoTitle: Senate Weighs Afternoon Impeachment Trial Schedule | FMB News
seoDescription: Senators are moving toward afternoon impeachment hearings, but current reports differ on whether the change begins immediately or after a final Senate decision.
deck: The Senate is considering a shift to afternoon impeachment proceedings so mornings can remain available for legislative work, but the exact implementation date remains unsettled in current reporting.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Senators are moving toward an afternoon schedule for the Vice President's impeachment trial as the chamber tries to balance impeachment proceedings with its regular legislative calendar.

An approved FMB News August 24 brief said the court would convene at 3:00 PM Monday. However, fresh public reporting is not fully consistent: News5 reported that the trial is being moved to an afternoon session, while separate reports said senators were still expected to finalize the schedule and that implementation could begin later.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Senate is simultaneously handling ordinary legislative work, including budget-related business, and its constitutional role as an impeachment court. Moving hearings later in the day is intended to preserve morning hours for plenary and committee work.
Because current same-day sources disagree on the precise opening time and implementation date, FMB News is not presenting a 3:00 PM Monday start as settled fact.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The timetable affects both the pace of the impeachment case and the Senate's ability to process legislation. A confirmed afternoon schedule could create longer or more predictable hearing windows without displacing morning legislative work.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for an official Senate or presiding-officer calendar confirming the start time, implementation date and any additional hearing days. That official notice should control over preliminary political statements or conflicting media reports.
